requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

645-1267-3899-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3899-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

4247-7084-7422.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2034-2267-5220-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-5220-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1090-1739-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-1753-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1753-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1976-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-2267-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1169-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1169-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2308-4050-4476-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4476-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Answered Prayers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1170-3363-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1170-3363-4668-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

967-997-3809-6753-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

967-2438-3129-3809-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2681-3814-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2681-3814-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Argothian Elder do not have summoning sickness.
2681-3814-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

341-2034-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Umori, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

880-3534-6763.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
880-3534-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4452-6633.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4452-6633.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a nonlegendary artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1978-2034-4702.description:
Activate the artifact creature with Splinter Twin attached by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature with Splinter Twin attached.
Repeat.

1283-3918-4896.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
1283-3918-4896.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

1486-1719-1753-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1719-1753-4875.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
1486-1719-1753-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

204-2909-5851.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-2909-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-2909-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {2}{U}{U} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

579-1636-1806-5168-5769.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one permanent of each color.
579-1636-1806-5168-5769.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Legacy Weapon by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
When Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

230-2252-2557-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-2557-4050.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1512-2034-2277-4275.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Wizards.
1512-2034-2277-4275.description:
Activate Supreme Inquisitor by tapping it, Stonybrook Schoolmaster, and any other three Wizards you control.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
Resolve the Supreme Inquisitor ability, causing you to search a player's library for five cards and exile them.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk Wizard, adding {C}{C}.
When the Merfolk Wizard dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolks and Wizards on the battlefield.
Repeat.

48-2232-2937.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
48-2232-2937.description:
Activate Xenagos's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding at least {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Cast Wrenn and Six by paying {R}{G}.
Wrenn and Six enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Xenagos from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Wrenn and Six's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Xenagos by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Xenagos enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wrenn and Six from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Xenagos' second ability to get infinite creature tokens.

628-855-2122-4050.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has an even number of +1/+1 counters on it.
628-855-2122-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 1 until Mindless Automaton has zero +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton, adding one mana of any color.
Mindless Automaton dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1778-2736-2773-3892.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {W}{U}{R}, giving Dissipation Field to any opponent.
Cast Memnite from your hand by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Memnite to deal one damage to the opponent that controls Dissipation Field.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Repeat from step 2 until the opponent dies.
When the opponent dies, you regain control of Dissipation Field.
Repeat from step 1 for each remaining opponent.

2882-4211-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4211-4675-4694.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Tormod's Crypt enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1987-3075-3941.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
813-1987-3075-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
